description:
Dooley Poynton Auctioneers are delighted to present this truly unique opportunity to acquire this exceptional four-bedroom detached, gated, private coastal residence and equestrian estate with one-bedroom self-contained apartment, & gym. This estate features an American barn, sand arena & paddocks set on c.5 Acres at the end of a quiet private cul de sac. This property is situated in one of the most scenic coastal locations in County Wicklow, offering spectacular views overlooking Wicklow Head Lighthouses and the Irish Sea. This location is truly second to none, occasionally one is privileged to behold a silhouette of Snowdonia, Wales appearing upon the horizon. This is not just a home; it’s a lifestyle, immerse yourself in the epitome of town, country & coastal living. The main house comprises of a welcoming entrance hallway, a Scandinavian styled living room with timber clad high ceilings, enhancing the sense of light and space, leading into the conservatory seamlessly connecting the interior to the exterior providing a serene vantage point to take in the coastal panoramas. The property features a kitchen/dining room with wood burning stove, utility room, study & four well-proportioned bedrooms, with master en-suite, family bathroom & guest w/c. The self-contained apartment features a kitchen, living room, bedroom & shower room to the rear there is a home gym.  The large garden & patio area is the perfect space to dine alfresco gazing out upon the horizon or overlooking the rolling Wicklow Hills. The grounds are adorned by mature native trees and hedging, offering a tranquil outdoor setting with an abundance of coastal & countryside charm. The surrounding countryside is ideal for nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts, with woodland walks & cycling routes. By night one can stargaze & marvel at the Milky Way courtesy of the dark night skies and by day you may enjoy regular sightings of the majestic Red Kite soaring overhead. The property is located only 6km from the golden sandy beaches of Brittas Bay & is adjacent to Wicklow Polo Club, and only a short drive from The Brittas Bay Club, Blainroe Golf Club, & Wicklow Golf Club. Wicklow’s vibrant Town Centre & Harbour are only c.2.5km away offering a selection of boutique shops, cafes, bars, & restaurants. If you’re looking for a little bit of heaven not far from the M11 this is the property for you. A.M.V €1,500.000


Directions: Please follow the Eircode A67EK82 for directions.

Entrance Hallway (3.66m x 10.80m)
This bright and inviting angled entrance hallway comprises of doors leading to the living room, kitchen/dining room, all four bedrooms, office, guest w/c and family bathroom. This space features ceiling cornice feature lighting, coving and solid wood flooring throughout.

Living Room (6.51m x 4.24m) 
This Scandinavian styled living room benefits from a triple aspect. The high ceilings and large expanses of glass allow light to flow seamlessly throughout this space. This space boasts an open fireplace with electric fire and a marble hearth. This well-proportioned space also features timber clad ceilings, recessed and wall lighting and also features solid wood flooring throughout. This space leads into the sun-drenched conservatory. 

Conservatory (4.00m x 3.46m)
This light infused conservatory features a pitched slate roof on the exterior. The interior features a timber clad ceiling with feature glass pendant lighting and solid wood flooring. This spaces offers a calm haven to relax or dine amidst the panoramic coastal views. French doors open out on to the large patio & landscaped garden making this the perfect space for entertaining guests.

Study (3.01m x 2.28m)
The study provides a quiet room of contemplation overlooking the front landscaped gardens. This space features a wall shelving, a ceiling cornice with pendant lighting and laminate flooring throughout. 

Kitchen/Dining Room (5.66m x 4.50m) 
This bright and spacious open-plan kitchen/dining room enjoys stunning coastal views. This space is infused with natural light, courtesy of the large expanses of glass. This space features a fully fitted shaker style kitchen with a stainless-steel sink unit, & back splash ceramic tiling. The kitchen comes equipped with an array of appliances including a Zanussi hob & oven, along with an additional double ring gas hob with stainless extractor fan, & Logik dishwasher. This space also features a wood burning stove, ceiling cornice with glass pendant lighting and laminate flooring throughout.

Utility Room (2.48m x 3.34m)
This bright utility room is plumbed for a washing machine/dryer and provides ample storage with built in cabinetry. This space is ideal as a boot room/cloakroom. This space features pendant lighting and laminate flooring. A door leads to the car port.

Family Bathroom (1.98m x 2.39m)
This bright family bathroom features a monochromatic colour scheme featuring a retro dark brown bathroom suite with beige ceramic floor to ceiling tiling. This space features a pedestal wash hand basin with shaving light and mirror, chrome towel rail, bidet, w/c and a bathtub with pump shower. 

Guest W/C (2.23m x 1.28m)
This angled contemporary guest w/c features a vanity unit with wash hand basin, mirror, toilet and ceramic Victorian styled floor to ceiling tiling. 

Master Bedroom (4.16m x 3.63m) 
This exceptionally bright master bedroom overlooks the landscaped gardens. This space features a custom built-in floor to ceiling wardrobe & dresser, a ceiling cornice with pendant lighting and solid wood flooring. This space provides a calm relaxing ambiance away from the rest of the house. 

Ensuite (2.52m x 2.40m)
The en-suite features pump shower, a toilet, vanity unit with wash hand basin & bidet. This space also features ceramic floor to ceiling tiling. 

Bedroom 2 (2.52m x 4.05m)
This bedroom is infused with natural light and enjoys a sunny aspect, overlooking sea views and the landscaped garden area. This space features pendant lighting and laminate flooring throughout.

Bedroom 3 (2.52m x 3.34m)
This bedroom overlooks the landscaped gardens to the front of the property. This space features a built-in wardrobe, pendant lighting and laminate flooring throughout.

Bedroom 4 (2.97m x 3.20m)
This bedroom enjoys a sunny aspect, overlooking sea views across the landscaped garden area. This space features a ceiling cornice with pendant lighting, a built-in wardrobe and laminate flooring throughout.

Self-Contained Apartment
The one-bedroom self-contained guest apartment features an open plan living/dining room with solid fuel stove, a separate kitchen, and one double bedroom with ensuite shower room.   

Gym (2.65m x 2.34m)
This own door gym is the perfect area to workout or train in peace and quiet away from the rest of the household

The Grounds
This beautiful estate features c.5 Acres of land with enviable sea and coastal views. The landscaped garden provides the perfect viewpoint to enjoy the views overlooking the surrounding countryside and the magnificent coastal vistas. One can enjoy the sweet sounds of the native bird song and the fragrant floral scents filling your senses.  The property boasts a cobble lock patio area perfect for alfresco dining along with selection of lawned areas to relax or play bordered by plants and shrubs. The grounds offer total privacy and seclusion bordered by flourishing native trees, Silver Birch and Scotch Pine. The extensive land is divided into paddocks sheltered by mature trees. There is ample private parking and a sheltered car port with two electric car charging points.

American Barn (c.18.4m x 27m)
This robust American Barn boasts a separate entrance with a concrete yard and lorry parking. This space provides the perfect sanctuary for equestrian lovers. The barn features five mare & foal loose boxes (c.3.74m x 4.1m) with individual feeding & water bowls & hay rack. The mare and foal boxes feature Kingspan cladding, galvanized box profile sheeting with wall and ceiling insulation. The barn also features an electric roller door, concrete floor throughout, a secure tack up area, machinery storage, hay/straw storage area along with a mezzanine level. The barn is serviced by electricity and water. 

Sand Arena (c.52m x 27m)
The Sand Arena is ideal for training or exercising, featuring a water ditch and water jump. The arena offers unparalleled views overlooking the Irish sea and the surrounding countryside.
